Name: Replacement Sensor Model Error Covariance Version A
Description: The Replacement Sensor Model Error Covariance Version A (RSMECA) TRE contains general error covariance information. The corresponding error covariance generated from this information is termed the RSM indirect error covariance.
Notes: The field ERRCVG should loop on <1/2(NUMOPG+1)(NUMOPG)<IGN>> instead of solely on <NUMOPG<IGN>>. The field MAP should loop on (NPAR)(NPARO) instead of solely on NPAR.

IID.Name: Image Identifier
IID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the original full image that corresponds to the associated image. This is not to be confused with the identification of an image derived by filtering, chipping, re-sampling, or other such image-to-image transformations. The image identifier is left justified with trailing spaces. This field is all spaces if N/A.

EDITION.Name: RSM Image Support Data Edition
EDITION.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the RSM support data for the associated original full image. It is to consist of an identifier of up to 20 characters for the processor that generated the RSM support data, to which is appended up to 20 characters that are unique among RSM TRE sets that are generated by that processor.

TID.Name: Triangulation ID
TID.Description: This field contains an identifier that is unique to the most recent process after RSM support data generation that led to the adjustments and/or error covariance in this RSM support data edition. The field value is all spaces if there has been no such process.

INCLIC.Name: Include Indirect Error Covariance Flag
INCLIC.Description: The indirect error covariance information is included in this TRE if the value in this field is Y.

INCLUC.Name: Include Unmodeled Error Covariance Flag
INCLUC.Description: The unmodeled error covariance information is included in this TRE if the value of this field is Y.

NPAR.Name: Number of RSM Adjustable Parameters
NPAR.Description: This field contains the number of (active) RSM adjustable parameters of the associated image. it is the dimension of both the row and the column dimensions of the (mapped) RSM image error covariance. The maximum allowed number of RSM adjustable parameters is 36.

NPARO.Name: Number of Original Adjustable Parameters
NPARO.Description: This field contains the number of original adjustable parameters of the associated image. It is both the row and column dimensions of the (unmapped) original image error covariance. The maximum allowed number of original adjustable parameters is 36.

IGN.Name: Number of Independent Subgroups
IGN.Description: This field contains the number of independent adjustable parameter (error) subgroups associated with the original adjustable parameters of the associated image.

CVDATE.Name: Version Date of the Original Image Error Covariance
CVDATE.Description: This field contains the date representing the version of the error model applicable to the original image error covariance. If populated, and two images are from the same sequence of images from the same sensor, and if the values of CVDATE are different in the two RSMECA TREs, all original adjustable parameter (errors) are assumed uncorrelated between the images. YYYY = four digit year, MM = two digit month, DD = two digit day. Default is all spaces.

XUOL.Name: Local Coordinate Origin (XUOL)
XUOL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X coordinate of the origin of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. This coordinate system is part of the RSM adjustable parameters definition for the image.

YUOL.Name: Local Coordinate Origin (YUOL)
YUOL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Y coordinate of the origin of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. This coordinate system is part of the RSM adjustable parameters definition for the image.

ZUOL.Name: Local Coordinate Origin (ZUOL)
ZUOL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Z coordinate of the origin of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. This coordinate system is part of the RSM adjustable parameters definition for the image.

XUXL.Name: Local Coordinate Unit Vector (XUXL)
XUXL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X component of the unit vector defining the x-axis of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. This coordinate system is part of the RSM adjustable parameters definition for the image. This value is consistent with fields XUXL through ZUZL forming an orthogonal matrix.

XUYL.Name: Local Coordinate Unit Vector (XUYL)
XUYL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X component of the unit vector defining the y-axis of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. This coordinate system is part of the RSM adjustable parameters definition for the image. This value is consistent with fields XUXL through ZUZL forming an orthogonal matrix.

XUZL.Name: Local Coordinate Unit Vector (XUZL)
XUZL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 X component of the unit vector defining the z-axis of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. This coordinate system is part of the RSM adjustable parameters definition for the image. This value is consistent with fields XUXL through ZUZL forming an orthogonal matrix.

YUXL.Name: Local Coordinate Unit Vector (YUXL)
YUXL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Y component of the unit vector defining the x-axis of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. This coordinate system is part of the RSM adjustable parameters definition for the image. This value is consistent with fields XUXL through ZUZL forming an orthogonal matrix.

YUYL.Name: Local Coordinate Unit Vector (YUYL)
YUYL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Y component of the unit vector defining the y-axis of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. YUZL.Name: Local Coordinate Unit Vector (YUZL)

ZUYL.Name: Local Coordinate Unit Vector (ZUYL)
ZUYL.Description: This field provides the WGS 84 Z component of the unit vector defining the y-axis of the Local (rectangular) coordinate system. IRO.Name: Image Row Constant Index
IRO.Description: This field provides the value of the index into the associated image's RSM Adjustment Vector for the RSM adjustable parameter: the constant offset adjustment of the image row position. A value of all spaces for the field specifies that this adjustable parameter is not active (not used).

IRX.Name: Image Row X Index
IRX.Description: The RSM error cross-covariance index associated with the following RSM adjustable parameter: the coefficient for ground point x position applied to the image row position. This field is all spaces if it is not used.

IRY.Name: Image Row Y Index
IRY.Description: The RSM error cross-covariance index associated with the following RSM adjustable parameter: the coefficient for ground point y position applied to the image row position. This field is all spaces if it is not used.

IRZ.Name: Image Row Z Index
IRZ.Description: The RSM error cross-covariance index associated with the following RSM adjustable parameter: the coefficient for ground point z position applied to the image row position. This field is all spaces if it is not used.

IRXY.Name: Image Row XY Index

IRYZ.Name: Image Row YZ Index

IRZZ.Name: Image Row Z^2 Index

ICO.Name: Image Column Constant Index
ICO.Description: The RSM error cross-covariance index associated with the following RSM adjustable parameter: the constant offset adjustment of the image column position. This field is all spaces if not used.

ICX.Name: Image Column X Index
ICX.Description: The RSM error cross-covariance index associated with the following RSM adjustable parameter: the coefficient for ground point x position applied to the image column position. This field is all spaces if not used.

ICY.Name: Image Column Y Index

GXR.Name: Ground Rotation X

NUMOPG<IGN>.Name: Number of Original Adjustable Parameters in Subgroup
NUMOPG<IGN>.Description: This field contains the number of contiguous original adjustable parameters in this independent error subgroup. (Independent error subgroups are contiguous as well).

ERRCVG<NUMOPG<IGN>>.Name: Original Error Covariance Element
ERRCVG<NUMOPG<IGN>>.Description: This field contains an original adjustable parameter error covariance element corresponding to the independent error subgroup. The elements correspond to the upper triangular portion of the error covariance. They are in row major order. Collectively, the ERRCVG values for the subgroup must correspond to a positive definite error covariance matrix.

TCDF<IGN>.Name: Time Correlation Domain Flag
TCDF<IGN>.Description: This field defines the type of original adjustable parameter error, and hence, the corresponding correlation function domain, for this independent error subgroup. If this field is 0, the time correlation applies to all time intervals, both within and between images, which are "image element errors". If this field is 1, the time correlation applies to time intervals between images only. Time correlation for time intervals within an image is defined 100% positively correlated. These errors are "image errors". If this field is 2, the time correlation applies to time intervals within an image only. Time correlation for time intervals between images is defined as zero. The errors are "restricted image element errors".

NCSEG<IGN>.Name: Number of Correlation Segments
NCSEG<IGN>.Description: This field contains the number of piece-wise linear correlation segments that make up the correlation function for this independent error subgroup.

CORSEG<NCSEG<IGN>>.Name: Segment Correlation Value
CORSEG<NCSEG<IGN>>.Description: This field contains the correlation value applicable at the beginning of the segment. Note that the value is defined as one for the first segment (correlation segment=1), and defined as zero for the last segment (correlation segment=NCSEG). It is a nonnegative number for all segments, decreasing in value from one segment to the next.

TAUSEG<NCSEG<IGN>>.Name: Segment Tau Value
TAUSEG<NCSEG<IGN>>.Description: This field contains the correlation time (tau) applicable at the beginning of the segment. Note that the value is defined as zero for the first segment (correlation segment=1). It is a positive number for all other segments, increasing in value from one segment to the next. Also, the last segment is defined equal to zero for all tau greater than the last segment's TAUSEG value.

MAP<NPAR>.Name: Mapping Matrix Element
MAP<NPAR>.Description: This field contains the value of the next mapping matrix element, stored in row major order. The mapping matrix is used to map the associated image's original error covariance to RSM error covariance. The mapping matrix has NPAR rows and NPARO columns.

URR.Name: Unmodeled Row Variance
URR.Description: This field provides the variance of unmodeled error represented as an image row error.

URC.Name: Unmodeled Row-Column Covariance
URC.Description: This field provides the covariance between the unmodeled error represented as an image row error and unmodeled error represented as an image column error. Collectively, URR, URC, and UCC values must correspond to a positive semi-definite (2x2) error covariance matrix.

UCC.Name: Unmodeled Column Variance
UCC.Description: This field provides the variance of unmodeled error represented as an image column error.

UNCSR.Name: Number of Correlation Segments for Independent Variable ROW Distance
UNCSR.Description: This field contains the number of piece-wise linear correlation segments that make up the correlation function for unmodeled error with independent variable image row distance.

UCORSR<UNCSR>.Name: Segment Correlation Value
UCORSR<UNCSR>.Description: This field contains the correlation value applicable at the beginning of the segment. Note that the value is defined as one for the first segment (correlation segment=1), and defined as zero for the last segment (correlation segment=UNCSR). It is a nonnegative number for all segments, decreasing in value from one segment to the next.

UTAUSR<UNCSR>.Name: Segment Tau Value
UTAUSR<UNCSR>.Description: This field contains the correlation row distance (tau) applicable at the beginning of the segment. Note that the value is defined as zero for the first segment (correlation segment=1). It is a positive number for all other segments, increasing in value from one segment to the next. Also, the last segment is defined equal to zero for all tau greater than the last segment's UTAUSR value.

UNCSC.Name: Number of Correlation Segments for Independent Variable Column Distance
UNCSC.Description: This field contains the number of piece-wise linear correlation segments that make up the correlation function for unmodeled error with independent variable image column distance.

UCORSC<UNCSC>.Name: Segment Correlation Value
UCORSC<UNCSC>.Description: This field contains the correlation value applicable at the beginning of the segment. Note that the value is defined as one for the first segment (correlation segment=1), and defined as zero for the last segment (correlation segment=UNCSC). It is a nonnegative number for all segments, decreasing in value from one segment to the next.

UTAUSC<UNCSC>.Name: Segment Tau Value
UTAUSC<UNCSC>.Description: This field contains the correlation column distance (tau) applicable at the beginning of the segment. Note that this value is defined as zero for the first segment (correlation segment=1). It is a positive number for all other segments, increasing in value from oe segment to the next. Also, the last segment correlation is defined equal to zero for all tau greater than the last segment's UTAUSC value.
